title: Rank-1 Weight-Corrected Trainable Weight Averaging for Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection identifies inputs outside the training distribution. Rank-based analyses such as RankFeat and RankWeight suggest that OOD overconfidence is closely related to dominant low-rank components in feature and weight spaces. Since weight averaging operates directly in parameter space and improves model generalization, we consider it for OOD detection from a dominant-component perspective. Trainable Weight Averaging (TWA) assigns a single coefficient to each checkpoint, limiting independent control of dominant weight components. We extend TWA with leading rank-one weight components extracted by Singular Value Decomposition as correction directions, whose contributions are learned through the in-distribution classification objective. On ResNet50, our method improves over fine-tuning and standard TWA across the evaluated datasets with MSP and RankWeight, both with and without Outlier Exposure. Mahalanobis-base

translated_title: 用于分布外检测的秩1权重校正可训练权重平均
translated_abstract: 分布外（OOD）检测旨在识别训练分布之外的输入。诸如RankFeat和RankWeight等基于秩的分析表明，OOD过度自信与特征空间和权重空间中的主导低秩分量密切相关。由于权重平均直接在参数空间中操作并能提升模型泛化能力，我们从主导分量的角度考虑将其用于OOD检测。可训练权重平均（TWA）为每个检查点分配单一系数，这限制了对主导权重分量的独立控制。我们利用通过奇异值分解提取的主要秩一权重分量作为校正方向来扩展TWA，这些分量的贡献通过分布内分类目标学习得到。在ResNet50上，无论是否使用离群值暴露，我们的方法在使用MSP和RankWeight的所有评估数据集上均优于微调和标准TWA。（原文摘要至"Mahalanobis-base"处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出在可训练权重平均（TWA）的基础上，引入通过奇异值分解提取的秩一权重分量作为校正方向，实现对主导权重分量的独立控制，从而在分布外检测任务上超越微调和标准TWA方法。
en_tdlr: This paper extends Trainable Weight Averaging (TWA) with leading rank-one weight components extracted via Singular Value Decomposition as correction directions, enabling independent control of dominant weight components and improving out-of-distribution detection over both fine-tuning and standard TWA.
